name: additive-api
description: Adds a new exported function multiply(value, factor) (half-away-from-zero rounding) to src/money.ts, re-exports it from src/index.ts, documents it in the README and tests it. No existing export changes, so the public API diff is additive.

claim.title: Add multiply() for scaling money by a factor

plan.title: Add multiply() for scaling money by a factor
plan.intent: Callers keep re-implementing tax and discount maths with ad-hoc rounding. Add multiply(value, factor) that scales an amount and rounds to the nearest minor unit, halves away from zero, without touching existing functions.
acceptanceCriteria: multiply(money(5, "EUR"), 0.5) is 3 cents and multiply(money(-5, "EUR"), 0.5) is -3 cents
multiply is exported from the package entry point and listed in the README
outOfScope: Changing add, subtract or any other existing export
Banker's rounding or configurable rounding modes

riskDeclarations.description: Adds one new export (multiply); existing signatures are unchanged.

failingOnBase: test/money.test.ts > multiply > scales by a whole factor
test/money.test.ts > multiply > rounds a fractional result to the nearest minor unit
test/money.test.ts > multiply > rounds halves away from zero
test/money.test.ts > multiply > returns a positive zero rather than negative zero
